notes.title: Update Notes for version 1.2
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who sent suggestions and reported bugs!

[list]
[*] Follow the Deep Ones in ruins to gain mutation in an easy way.
[*] Unlimited madness, you can escape Asylum as this ending is optional now.
[*] Repeated ritual is fixed, as well as some other inconsistencies in text.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.1
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who reports bugs! The recent changes:

[list]
[*] You can sell your body in the tavern after the first whore event
[*] Easier to get Cobb's achievement
[*] Fixed event when Vick pulls you into his cabin.
[*] Azumi sex count is more correct
[*] Day number is now displayed in Info tab
[*] More correct display of saves info
[/list]

notes.title: Critical patch
notes.content: There was an issue with Cave Ritual event and quick fix actually created new problems with save files.  This patch is more radical and some saves can be corrupted, still they should be playable (from cave event). Sorry for that.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758570/29475e9075b6ccad2732ca1f5c8b4331ca9a05e5.jpg[/img]

The Allure Of Wanton Cove will be part of the Steam Next Fest starting next Monday, June 10. The event will be going on for a week. We hope the game will find some new players!

[h2]Demo update[/h2]
We fixed all the bugs we could find, and decided to add animations for characters' overlays - they look much more live now.
